_meta.description: SemanticCache store for customer-service chatbot — billing, FAQ, templates, and escalation scripts
_meta.note: embedding_vector values are abbreviated to 8 dimensions for readability; production vectors are 1536-dimensional

entries.query: What is your refund policy for double charges?
entries.result: If you have been charged twice for the same transaction, you are entitled to a full refund of the duplicate charge. Our refund policy guarantees resolution within 3–5 business days. To initiate a refund, please provide your order number and the date of the duplicate charge. Our billing team will verify the transaction and process the refund automatically to your original payment method. You will receive an email confirmation once the refund is issued. If you do not see the refund within 7 business days, please contact us again and we will escalate to our payment processor.

entries.query: What are your customer support hours?
entries.result: Our customer support team is available Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM Eastern Time, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time. We are closed on Sundays and major U.S. public holidays. For urgent issues outside business hours, you can submit a ticket through our online portal and a representative will respond by the next business day. Premium support customers have access to 24/7 phone support — please check your account plan for eligibility.

entries.query: How do I cancel my subscription?
entries.result: You can cancel your subscription at any time through the Account Settings page. Navigate to Settings → Billing → Subscription, then click 'Cancel Subscription'. Your access will remain active until the end of your current billing period. If you cancel within 14 days of your initial purchase, you qualify for a full refund under our satisfaction guarantee. After 14 days, no partial refunds are issued for unused time. To prevent accidental cancellation, you will be asked to confirm your decision twice. If you cancel and wish to reactivate later, your account history and data will be preserved for 90 days.

entries.query: What payment methods do you accept?
entries.result: We accept the following payment methods: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and ACH bank transfers for annual plans. All credit and debit card payments are processed securely via Stripe. We do not accept cash, checks, or cryptocurrency. For enterprise customers, we also offer invoice-based NET-30 billing. If your preferred payment method is not listed, please contact our billing support team to discuss alternatives.

entries.query: Can I get a refund after 30 days?
entries.result: Our standard refund window is 14 days from the date of purchase. After 30 days, we are generally unable to issue refunds for digital products and subscription services, as outlined in our Terms of Service. However, exceptions may be made in cases of technical failure attributable to our platform, billing errors caused by our systems, or documented medical or family emergencies. To request an exception, please contact our billing team with supporting documentation. Each exception request is reviewed individually by our billing manager.

entries.query: What is the standard apology for a service outage?
entries.result: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the recent service disruption. Our engineering team identified the root cause and has fully restored service. We understand how disruptive outages can be to your workflow, and we take full responsibility for this experience. As a gesture of goodwill, we have applied a 10% credit to your next invoice. If you experienced data loss or additional business impact, please contact our support team and we will work with you to find an appropriate resolution. We are committed to improving our infrastructure to prevent similar incidents in the future.

entries.query: How do I update my billing address?
entries.result: To update your billing address, log in to your account and navigate to Settings → Billing → Payment Information. Click 'Edit Billing Address' and enter your new address details. Changes take effect immediately and will appear on your next invoice. If your billing address is associated with a tax exemption certificate, please also update your tax information in the same section. For enterprise accounts, billing address changes may require approval from your account administrator. If you need assistance, our billing support team is available during business hours.

entries.query: What is your policy on unauthorized account access?
entries.result: If you suspect unauthorized access to your account, please take the following steps immediately: (1) Change your password by clicking 'Forgot Password' on the login page. (2) Enable two-factor authentication under Settings → Security. (3) Review your account activity log for any unrecognized actions. (4) Contact our security team by emailing security@company.com or calling our dedicated fraud line. We will investigate the incident, temporarily freeze any suspicious activity, and help you secure your account. We take security incidents very seriously and will work with you to determine whether any data was accessed or modified.

entries.query: How long does a refund take to process?
entries.result: Refunds are typically processed within 3–5 business days from the date of approval. Once processed on our end, the time for the funds to appear in your account depends on your payment method: credit cards take 5–10 business days, debit cards take 3–7 business days, PayPal refunds appear within 1–3 business days, and ACH bank transfers take 7–10 business days. You will receive an email notification when the refund is initiated. If you have not received your refund after 10 business days, please contact your bank or payment provider first, and then reach out to our billing support team with your refund confirmation number.

entries.query: What is the escalation script for a very upset customer?
entries.result: Thank you for bringing this to my attention, and I sincerely apologize that your experience has been so frustrating. I completely understand your disappointment, and I want to assure you that your concern is being taken seriously. I am escalating your case right now to our senior support team who have the authority to resolve this at the highest priority level. You will receive a direct call or email from a senior team member within the next 2 hours during business hours, or first thing the next business day. I am personally noting the urgency of your situation in your ticket. Is there anything else I can do for you right now while I arrange that escalation?

entries.query: Do you offer discounts for non-profit organizations?
entries.result: Yes, we offer a 30% discount for registered non-profit organizations. To apply, visit our Non-Profit Program page and submit your application along with a copy of your IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter or equivalent international documentation. Our team reviews applications within 5 business days. Approved organizations receive a discount code applied to all future billing cycles. The discount is valid for all plan tiers and can be combined with annual billing savings. Non-profit pricing is available for up to 50 user seats; larger organizations should contact our sales team for custom pricing.

entries.query: How do I export my data before canceling?
entries.result: Before canceling your account, you can export all your data in JSON or CSV format from the Settings → Data Management → Export page. The export includes all records, documents, configurations, and activity logs associated with your account. Large exports (over 500 MB) are delivered via an email download link within 2 hours. After your account is canceled, your data is retained in our systems for 90 days during which you can reactivate and re-export. After 90 days, all data is permanently deleted in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable data protection regulations. We recommend exporting before canceling to avoid any possibility of data loss.

entries.query: What happens if a payment fails?
entries.result: If a payment fails, we will automatically retry the charge 3 times over the following 7 days (on days 1, 3, and 7). You will receive an email notification after each failed attempt with instructions to update your payment method. During the retry window, your account remains fully active. If all three retries fail, your account will be downgraded to a free tier (or suspended, depending on your plan type) and you will have 14 days to resolve the payment before your data is affected. To update your payment method immediately, go to Settings → Billing → Payment Information. Once the outstanding balance is paid, your account is restored to full access immediately.

entries.query: Is my data secure on your platform?
entries.result: Yes. We take data security extremely seriously. All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 encryption. Our infrastructure is hosted on AWS in SOC 2 Type II certified data centers located in the US and EU. We conduct annual third-party penetration tests and maintain a bug bounty program. Access controls are enforced with role-based permissions and all privileged access is logged and audited. We are compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA (for applicable plans). You can review our full Security Overview and compliance certifications at trust.company.com. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for advertising purposes.

entries.query: Can I switch plans mid-billing cycle?
entries.result: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately — you will be charged a prorated amount for the remainder of the billing cycle and gain access to new features instantly. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle; you continue to have access to your current plan's features until that date and no partial refund is issued for the difference. To change your plan, go to Settings → Billing → Change Plan and select your desired tier. If you are on an annual plan, downgrades may result in a plan credit rather than a direct refund, depending on timing. Contact billing support if you need help calculating the cost impact.

entries.query: What is your SLA for resolving billing disputes?
entries.result: Our Service Level Agreement for billing disputes guarantees the following response and resolution times: Initial acknowledgment within 1 business day of submission. Investigation completed within 5 business days. Written resolution decision provided within 7 business days. If we determine a billing error occurred, the corrected charge or refund is processed within 3 business days of that decision. For disputes involving amounts over $500, we escalate to our billing manager who provides a personal response within 2 business days. All billing disputes can be submitted through the Help Center under 'Billing Dispute Form' or by emailing billing@company.com with your invoice number and a description of the issue.

entries.query: Do you offer a free trial?
entries.result: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial on all paid plan tiers. No credit card is required to start your trial. During the trial period you have full access to all features of the plan you selected. At the end of the 14 days, you will receive a reminder email. If you do not add a payment method and subscribe, your account will automatically convert to our free tier (with limited features). Your data and configurations are preserved for 30 days on the free tier, giving you time to decide. You can start a free trial by clicking 'Try Free for 14 Days' on our pricing page. Each email address is eligible for one free trial.

entries.query: What should I say to a customer who received the wrong item?
entries.result: Hello [Customer Name], I'm truly sorry to hear that you received the incorrect item — that is absolutely not the experience we want you to have. Please accept my sincere apologies for this error. To make this right as quickly as possible, we will: (1) Arrange a free return pickup of the incorrect item at a time that is convenient for you — no packaging required. (2) Ship the correct item immediately, with expedited shipping at no charge, estimated to arrive within 2 business days. (3) Apply a $15 courtesy credit to your account for the inconvenience. You do not need to take any action right now; I will initiate these steps on my end as soon as we confirm your shipping address. Can you please confirm the address where we should deliver the correct item?

entries.query: Is there a limit to how many users I can add?
entries.result: User seat limits depend on your plan: Free plan allows 1 user, Starter plan allows up to 5 users, Professional plan allows up to 25 users, Business plan allows up to 100 users, and Enterprise plan offers unlimited users. If you need more users than your current plan allows, you can either upgrade to the next tier or add individual user seats at $12 per seat per month on the Professional plan and $10 per seat per month on the Business plan. User seat add-ons are prorated when added mid-cycle. To manage your users, go to Settings → Team → Manage Members. For Enterprise pricing, contact our sales team for a custom quote based on your organization's size.

entries.query: What is the escalation script for a technical outage affecting a business customer?
entries.result: Dear [Customer Name], I want to reach out personally to acknowledge the service disruption your team is experiencing. I fully understand the business impact of downtime, and I want to assure you this is our highest priority right now. Here is our current status: Our engineering team identified the root cause at [TIME] and has been working continuously to restore service. Current estimated resolution time is [ETA]. I will send you a personal status update every 30 minutes until full service is restored. Once resolved, you will receive a detailed incident report within 24 hours outlining root cause, remediation steps, and preventive measures. As compensation for the impact to your business, we will apply a service credit of [AMOUNT] to your account. Please reply to this message with any questions — I am personally monitoring this incident and will respond immediately.

entries.query: How does annual billing work?
entries.result: Annual billing allows you to pay for a full year upfront at a discounted rate, typically saving 20% compared to monthly billing. Your annual subscription begins on the date of purchase and renews automatically one year later unless you cancel. You will receive a renewal reminder 30 days before your renewal date. If you cancel an annual subscription within the first 14 days, you receive a full refund. After 14 days, annual plans are non-refundable, though you retain access for the remainder of the paid year. Switching from monthly to annual billing takes effect immediately — you pay the annual price minus the prorated credit from your unused monthly period. Contact billing support for help calculating the exact cost to switch.

entries.query: What integrations do you support?
entries.result: We currently support over 80 native integrations, including: CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive), communication tools (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Gmail, Outlook), project management (Jira, Asana, Trello, Monday.com), accounting software (QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks), e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce), and data/analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Tableau). All integrations are available on the Professional plan and above. A full list of integrations with setup guides is available at integrations.company.com. If you need a custom integration not listed, our API supports REST and webhooks, and our Enterprise plan includes dedicated integration support.

entries.query: What is the policy for disputed transactions through a bank?
entries.result: If a customer files a chargeback or payment dispute directly with their bank or credit card issuer, our billing team will receive a dispute notification from the payment processor. We have a dedicated team that responds to all chargebacks within the required timeframe (typically 7–10 days). During the dispute investigation period, access to the account may be temporarily suspended to protect both parties. If the chargeback is resolved in our favor, the customer's account is reinstated immediately. If the chargeback is resolved in the customer's favor, the account is closed. We strongly encourage customers to contact us directly before initiating a chargeback, as we can often resolve billing issues faster than the bank dispute process, which can take 30–90 days.

entries.query: Do you have a referral program?
entries.result: Yes! Our referral program lets you earn account credits by referring friends and colleagues. For each person who signs up using your unique referral link and subscribes to a paid plan, you receive a $25 account credit and your referred friend receives a $10 discount on their first month. There is no limit to how many people you can refer. Credits are applied automatically after the referred user completes their first paid billing cycle. You can find your unique referral link in Settings → Account → Referral Program. Credits do not expire and can be applied toward any future invoices. For enterprise referrals (contracts over $5,000/year), our sales team offers enhanced referral incentives — contact us for details.

entries.query: How do I request a copy of my invoice?
entries.result: Invoices are available at any time in your account under Settings → Billing → Invoice History. You can view, download (PDF), or email any invoice directly from that page. Invoices are generated automatically at the start of each billing cycle and are also emailed to your account's billing contact address. If you need invoices sent to a different email address (e.g., your accounting department), you can add a secondary billing contact under Settings → Billing → Billing Contacts. For bulk invoice exports or custom invoice formats required for enterprise accounting systems, please contact our billing support team. Invoices are retained in your account for a minimum of 7 years in compliance with accounting regulations.
